Verdict vs the "High-level architecture design" picture
--------------------------------------------------------
  present + measured : Sensing→Perception, Sensing→Localization,
                       Localization→{Perception, Planning, Control},
                       Map→{Localization, Perception, Planning}
  present but silent : Perception→Planning, Planning→Control (scenario gap)
  plant substitutes  : bag = Vehicle Interface (ext:in), control_cmd → ext:out
  extra vs picture   : /system→control (MRM/emergency), /adapi layer,
                       localization→sensing feedback
  new information    : coupling KIND per link (trigger vs sampled) and the
                       NUMBER (hop latency / data age): all of control's
                       inputs are sampled — pose 38 ms, steering 56 ms,
                       MRM 198 ms; static inputs (map 68 s, mode 5 s)
                       separate from live ones by age.

CORRECTION (2026-08-17 night, after the polled-subscription model — see cp_1)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
r11 re-modelled with detect_polled_subs: 66 polled sub F's, 71 polled links
(19 011 polled takes). The Layer B table above changes as follows:
  /perception → /planning   sampled ×3  n=1227  age p50 121.5 ms
        (objects, obstacle_segmentation/pointcloud, occupancy_grid_map/map)
        → the "NOT ACTIVE (zero_exec subs)" verdict was WRONG in kind: the
          subscription callbacks never fire because planning polls them
          from its timers; the DATA DID FLOW, planning produced no
          trajectory only because there was no route.
  /perception → /control    sampled ×2  n=736   125.7 ms  (AEB reads objects + pointcloud)
  /sensing    → /control    sampled ×1  n=245   35.7 ms   (imu_data)
  /planning   → /control    sampled ×1  n=237   182.2 ms  (hazard_lights_cmd only — no trajectory, no route)
  /localization → /control  sampled ×2  n=7161 (was 4372) 37.4 ms
All other rows unchanged (the rule adds links, it does not alter measured ones).
Verdict line "present but silent: Perception→Planning" → "present, sampled,
measured (121 ms); Planning→Control still silent (no route)".
